Sam (Support): 2026-03-14 14:12 UTC - Customer acct_9Z7 reported repeated SSE disconnects mid-stream. They see partial output and then a 429 returned, connection closed. They claim billing shows fewer tokens billed than tokens in returned output.

Sam (Support): repro attached below. customer uses long-form generation (~6k tokens). Example client curl:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-large" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":6000,"stream":true}'
```

Sam (Support): On their side they get a few hundred KB of chunks then one chunk with `event: error` and HTTP/1.1 429 in the wire capture. After that connection closes and last partial chunk isn't marked as complete. Customer sends complaint: "we got half the summary and our app treats it as final, user lost data".

Sam (Support): Server-side excerpt from customer's request (redacted ids):

```
[2026-03-14T14:10:03Z] req_id=rcpt_4a5 stream_open acct=acct_9Z7 model=redwood-large
[2026-03-14T14:10:25Z] token_emit count=2782
[2026-03-14T14:10:26Z] quota_check result=exhausted remaining=0 -> issuing 429 mid-stream
[2026-03-14T14:10:26Z] stream_close reason=quota_exhausted http_status=429
```

Ingrid (SRE): are we pre-charging tokens or counting them after emission? If we count after emission, that could explain the ledger mismatch — customer sees tokens in stream but billing ledger hasn't recorded them when quota triggers 429.

Alex (Platform): We currently update the usage ledger in an async batch that fires on stream_close. If stream_close happens with 429 mid-stream we abort the batch and never reconcile those emitted tokens. That's a bug. Proposed immediate mitigation: on quota hit mid-stream convert 429 into a final SSE 'event: rate_limit' followed by `data: [TRUNCATED_BY_QUOTA]` and `data: [DONE]` then close gracefully. That lets clients treat output as complete.

Maria (Billing): If tokens were emitted but not recorded we need a reconciliation run. I can run a recovery job to scan logs between 2026-03-14T14:09 and 14:20 for req_id pattern and reapply deltas. Need confirmation before writing invoices. Also need a one-off credit if customer was charged incorrectly.

Sam (Support): Customer wants repro steps we can share and a short-term workaround: either raise their quota temporarily or disable streaming (non-stream endpoint returns full response if possible). They've accepted temporary quota bump.

Ingrid (SRE): Root cause paths:
- ledger write happens at stream_close and is skipped if quota enforcement returns early with 429 abort
- streaming codepath treats 429 as hard abort w/o sending final SSE event
- clients interpret truncated SSE as final output

Ingrid (SRE): Short-term fix (shipping today to staging): ensure ledger updates are performed incrementally (emit-time checkpoint) or at minimum on quota error we run the same ledger flush synchronously before closing. Also change server behavior to send a final SSE event before close. I'll open PR.

Alex (Platform): PR #11072 created: changes include `usage_checkpoint()` on token flush, and `send_sse_error(event="rate_limit", message="quota_exhausted")` before close. Can we hotfix to hosted region eu-west-1 first? deploy-bot: staging build queued.

deploy-bot: queued hotfix: project=streams runtime hotfix/11072 -> staging at 2026-03-14T21:00 UTC. If staging tests pass, promote to canary 1% then 10%.

rate-limit-bot: automatic alert - high 429 rate for acct_9Z7 between 14:10 and 14:15, rule=stream-429-midstream.

Maria (Billing): I'll run the reconciliation script after Ingrid's patch lands and we can re-bill. If the ledger shows undercounted tokens, we'll issue credits.

Sam (Support): Action items:
- Ingrid: push hotfix to staging + canary and confirm SSE final event behavior (ETA 6h)
- Alex: review PR and help with canary rollout (ETA 2h)
- Maria: prepare reconciliation script and hold off invoices until patch verified (ETA 12h)
- Sam: keep customer updated + apply temporary quota bump (done at 14:30 UTC)

Sam (Support): logs and wire captures uploaded to the support ticket #SUP-2431. I'll follow up after staging results.

Ingrid (SRE): quick note - telemetry change: add metric `streaming.quota.failures.post_emit` so we can catch these earlier.

Alex (Platform): will add a regression test in the streaming integration harness that simulates mid-stream quota exhaustion and asserts final SSE emission and ledger checkpoint.

Sam (Support): thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll close out this thread once reconciliation is done and customer confirmed.
